title: Redundant "Power off" and "Power down" actions exposed in global shortcuts KCM
line: The Shortcuts page now lists the power button's actions as "Power Button" and "Power Button Long Press" instead of the confusing "Power Off" and "Power Down".
explanation: Powerdevil registers two global shortcuts for the power button: one for a normal press (Qt::Key_PowerOff) and one for a long press (Qt::Key_PowerDown, sent by KWin). They were labelled "Power Off" and "Power Down", which look like duplicate names for the same action. The change renames them "Power Button" and "Power Button Long Press"; the action ids and default keys stay the same, so existing shortcuts keep working.

commits.message:
handlebuttonevents: name the power button shortcuts after the button

The Shortcuts page listed "Power Off" and "Power Down", which read like
two names for the same thing although one is the power button press and
the other its long press. Name them "Power Button" and its long press.

BUG: 425915

media.caption: Shortcuts > Power Management on master: "Power Down" and "Power Off" (sweep tester's shot)
With the fix: "Power Button" and "Power Button Long Press", same keys

review.text: Simple and sensible fix in powerdevil that renames the ambiguous "Power Off" and "Power Down" global shortcuts to "Power Button" and "Power Button Long Press". Keeping the internal action IDs and default keys preserves existing user shortcuts and Plasma Mobile's long-press handling while clearly distinguishing the two actions in the Shortcuts KCM. Screenshots confirm the improved presentation.
